assumptions: Explicit scenario inputs are required; abiogenesis is not synthesized.
P6 remains the canonical biosphere boundary; V2X-08 outputs are model-derived only.
limitations: The single-file facade is a bounded convergence implementation and does not reproduce every research or ESM exploration kernel.
Trait variation and speciation are proposals only until admitted by governed temporal/gameplay authority.
Local samples do not establish global abundance.

fidelity.validity: Explicit model scenarios plus read-only P6 canonical biosphere boundary.
fidelity.resolution: At most 64 populations, 128 lineages, 256 interactions, 16 traits per lineage and 128 local samples.
fidelity.uncertainty: No canonical alien-biology, abiogenesis, universal mutation-rate or universal species-threshold claim.
